questions.sectionTitle: Module 2: Cloud Networking (VPC) & Storage Architectures Checkpoint
questions.prompt: Why does placing application containers inside a Private Subnet with a NAT Gateway enhance security over Public Subnets?

options.text: Instances have no public IPv4 address reachable for unsolicited inbound scans while still able to initiate outbound API/package calls cleanly
NAT Gateways automatically encrypt SQL queries inside JSON
Private subnets turn off CPU hyperthreading

questions.explanation: NAT Gateways allow initiated outbound sessions while blocking unsolicited inbound internet connections.

questions.prompt: Which firewall construct operates statelessly at the subnet boundary evaluating inbound and outbound ACL numbers separately?
questions.explanation: NACLs are stateless packet filters evaluated at subnet edges; Security Groups are stateful.

questions.prompt: Why do organizations enforce 'Block Public Access' on S3 and generate short-lived Pre-Signed URLs for private downloads?

options.text: To keep buckets strictly private and ensure users only fetch authorized files for brief expiration windows
Pre-Signed URLs compress PDF files by 80%
S3 prohibits HTTPS unless URLs expire
To speed up local hard disk formatting

questions.explanation: Pre-signed URLs delegate temporary credentialed GET/PUT authority cleanly after app authorization.
